senses.gloss: f.(b. h. מַשְׂרֵת; v. נָסַר)a mould for frying a batter (חָלוּט), in gen. pan.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:4">Ḥall. I, 4</cite> <he>חלת המ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>המַשְׂ׳</he>) cake formed in the mould; <cite ref="Pesachim 37a">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite>; expl.
ib. חלוט של וכ׳ home-made ḥalut (v. חָלַט I). Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵈ, v. חֲלִיטָא III.
